visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a screen recording of an MSI official product page for a monitor. In the bottom right corner, a male creator with black-rimmed glasses and a black t-shirt is visible in a small circular webcam frame. He is sitting in a room with warm indoor lighting and a Christmas tree in the background. (2) The scene transitions to a high-energy cinematic graphic displaying the product name 'MPG 272URX QD-OLED' in glowing neon blue text against a dark background with digital light streaks. (3) The view shifts back to the creator, now occupying the center frame as he gestures with his hands while describing the product. Behind him, the home setting is clearly visible, featuring a sofa and a modern interior. (4) The scene cuts to a screen capture of a gaming interface with Chinese text and character avatars, accompanied by a scrolling live chat on the left side of the frame. (5) Detailed close-up graphics of the monitor specifications appear, highlighting features like '240Hz' and '0.03ms' in stylized, high-contrast white text overlays. (6) The creator returns to the main frame, holding up three fingers to emphasize a 'three-year' warranty point. He points towards the screen while maintaining a smiling and engaged facial expression. (7) A screen recording of a technical article titled 'MSI OLED CARE' is shown, detailing the technology's benefits. Yellow variety captions appear at the bottom to emphasize his spoken points. (8) The video transitions to high-intensity gameplay footage of an action RPG, showcasing vibrant colors, particle effects, and cinematic combat scenes. (9) The final phase shows the creator again, concluding his talk while social media icons for Facebook and the MSI logo appear on a white background as part of a screen recording.

A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual transition. (2) As the product specs are read, the speaker's pitch rises with excitement. A metallic 'impact' sound effect punctuates the mention of '240Hz'. (3) A brief shift in ambient noise occurs as the speaker moves, followed by a 'pop' sound effect as variety text appears on screen. The music maintains a steady 4/4 beat. (4) A mechanical 'click' is audible as the scene cuts to gameplay. The speaker's voice becomes more exaggerated and comedic, using a higher arousal level to describe the 'immersive' feeling. (5) A distinct 'ding' notification sound effect triggers a new phase where the speaker mentions the website link. The BGM slightly lowers in volume to give space to the final call to action.
